items.title: GSK (LSE:GSK) Settles Key Vaccine Patent Case And Wins Broad Europe Injunction
items.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) reached a cross-licensing agreement with Moderna resolving their COVID-19 vaccine patent dispute in Europe. The pharma group secured a significant injunction against Pfizer-BioNTech covering liposome delivery technology used in RNA vaccines across multiple European markets. Ongoing legal actions and expected appeals around this RNA and liposome IP framework now shape how the largest vaccine makers operate in Europe. items.title: Why Is Moderna (MRNA) Joining A Global Benchmark And Publishing New Vaccine Data?
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) is scheduled to join the MSCI World Index in November 2026, which would add the stock to a major global benchmark. The biotech group reported publication of real world data on its mNEXSPIKE COVID-19 vaccine in older adults in a peer reviewed journal. The new study compared mNEXSPIKE effectiveness in reducing severe COVID-19 and hospitalizations among older adults against other available options.
